initialization.isolation: new process and new Param/Technology/MemCell/modules for each configuration
initialization.method: specialize a reviewed whitelist of constructor INPUT assignments in local Param.cpp before constructing; preserve formulas; record exact diff and hashes
initialization.algorithm_fields: explicit precision, physical shape, per-cell bits, mux and active row count before module construction; centralized synchronized derived fields only
initialization.forbidden: post-constructor ad hoc changes to node, resistance, temperature or any primary with uncatalogued dependents
required_order: constructor input specialization and fresh Param
snapshot_fields: MemCell mode-specific voltage/resistance/capacitance and native geometry
module actual dimensions, levelOutput, mux, numRead, numAdd

clock.actual_rule: max(target_period_ns, sensing_critical_path_ns, used_combinational_path_ns); use same actual period in count pass and conversion
clock.main_route: regression only; never use main sensing clkPeriod as a substitute for slower actual target period
clock.dff_caveat: cycle count is not frequency closure evidence

calibration.primitive_sar_latency: (log2(levelOutput)+1)*1e-9*numRead; do not add beta again outside a calibrated aggregate

scope.gamma: DFF dynamic energy where validated is supplied
scope.zeta: main-level final energy efficiency denominator; not primitive delay

parameter_ownership.device_native: original technology, load, bias, pulse, full opaque cycle retained per case; never scaled to 22nm automatically
parameter_ownership.hardware_inputs: ADC/SA/lane/mux/hold/driver/port/domain counts explicit from case spec
parameter_ownership.backend_defaults: RC/gate models and documented fit/table/constant implementations; relevant defaults snapshot
parameter_ownership.binding_change: all named consumers, maintenance busy time and nonpreemptive guard recompute; do not retain old alpha

counting.outer_counts_owner: case services count; declare any already included input bits/weight planes/row groups/mux/shift-add
counting.zero_input: data-dependent switching/current may change; fixed v3 phases and scheduled work never skipped
counting.steady_state: initiation_interval remains null without resource and scheduling proof
counting.opaque_cycles: retain complete; do not subtract guessed peripheral component
counting.payload: B_S=K*bytes_per_input, B_R=K*N*bytes_per_weight; restore/refresh contributes zero workload write payload
counting.digital_schedule: Existing v3 register-to-register scheduled ticks remain the repetition source. Combinational Adder/AdderTree results constrain actual_period, not another serial cycle charge. Each scheduled register capture is timed once by DFF=1 cycle. Alternate composed schedules must explicitly replace the source tick schedule, not add to it.

branch_routes.2DTrainingV2.1: incremental-update mechanism only; v3 complete update transactions remain primary
branch_routes.MLPInferenceV3.0: cell electrical/pulse and hybrid reference only
branch_routes.2DInferenceDCIMV1.0-dev: 256x256 native reference only, reject mapping D6 128x16 as native
branch_routes.2DInferenceV1.5-dev: Cap comparison only, external chargeDelay does not predict HZO restore or GC refresh

unimplemented: value=null with explicit status/reason; raw zero writeLatency is not a zero-time update

module_routes.conversion: SarADC direct primitive seconds, levelOutput=2^bits, numRead=1; lane and outer batch count separate
module_routes.digital: explicit Adder or AdderTree plus declared DFF resources; no implicit ShiftAdd pipeline
module_routes.ShiftAdd: comparison only unless internal registers/numReadPulse and overlap match reference; never blindly set numReadPulse=1
module_routes.SwitchMatrix: read only with explicit param unitcap/unitres/numColSubArray/buffernumber/drivecapin binding; synchronous write mixed units rejected
module_routes.SRAMWriteDriver: valid RC primitive; complete v3 ordinary SRAM write cycle remains opaque in main pilot
module_routes.LevelShifter: low-level RC/area reference only; no full pump, settle, recovery or verify coverage
